query: 水风险评估 水风险评估 衡量企业识别、评估和管理水风险的体系成熟度。 内容质量得分 (取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：使用了专业风险识别工具（如 WRI Aqueduct），具备水压力情景分析，有针对高风险站点的应对措施，且建立了水资源治理机制（如首席水官或专项考核）。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的水风险识别和定性描述，具备通用性应对措施（如节水计划），但缺乏针对性工具应用或深度的情景评估。 • 0分（不合格）：无水风险评估披露，或仅笼统提及“重视水资源保护”。 水风险评估 水压力 基准水压力 水资源短缺 干旱风险 洪涝风险 流域风险 高水压力地区 高风险站点 水压力情景分析 WRI Aqueduct WWF水风险过滤器 water risk assessment water stress baseline water stress water scarcity drought risk flood risk basin risk high water stress areas high-risk sites water stress scenario WRI Aqueduct WWF Water Risk Filter 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '水风险评估'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视节水”；仅有用水效益目标而无风险评估；仅有排污合规数据；仅有社区饮水公益项目；区分：水风险评估关注风险识别工具、情景与高风险站点应对；用水效益目标与行动方案关注节水量化目标及工程/管理措施，二者不可互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: SDGs | Actions by Beijing Enterprises Urban Resources Priorities • We attach great importance to occupational health and safe production and have established a solid HSE 1 system, as well as adopting various measures to effectively protect the health and safety of employees. Meanwhile, we are attentive to the mental health of employees and conduct various activities to protect the health and well-being of our employees. • In addition, we are capable of treating 44 out of the 46 major hazardous wastes in the National Hazardous Waste List, which greatly reduces the health risks faced by the public due to exposure to hazardous waste. • We ensure that in the recruitment and work process, we do not adopt any kind of unequal treatment of employees based on their gender. In 2021, our female employees accounted for 48% of the total employees. • We strictly abide by laws, regulations, and national and local standards to treat sewage and leachate generated during operation. For project companies that have no treatment capacities, we engage with qualified third parties for treatment to avoid water pollution as much as possible. • We have gradually selected new energy hygiene vehicles to replace traditional gasoline vehicles in project operations to speed up the construction of a clean, efficient, safe and sustainable energy supply system.

results.section: Improve ESG governance structure / Ensure fulfillment of social responsibility
results.text: We build a systematic ESG governance structure at the governance, management and executive levels. The Board of Directors supervises ESG matters and assumes overall responsibility for ESG strategies and reporting, and authorizes the Audit Committee to be the professional committee for overseeing ESG management. The Audit Committee regularly reports to the Board of Directors on major issues related to ESG work; the management is responsible for the specific implementation of ESG strategies and goals. The ESG functional departments of the headquarters form an ESG working group, which is responsible for the development of specific ESG work in their respective work areas; each subsidiary conducts ESG work in its territories under the guidance of the ESG working group. The establishment of the ESG governance structure ensures that the environmental and social risks involved in various businesses are managed, and enables the effective implementation of ESG concepts and strategies.
